video_title: Zach LaVine on Kings' mindset at 1-11, where they've seen progress, but still needing to be better

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on the Kings' frustrating 1-11 start
quotes.excerpt: It's frustrating we're trying to keep everybody together the right spirits and that's our job as well.
quotes.quote: It was a tough competitive game, another winnable game for us, but we fell short. It's frustrating we're trying to keep everybody together the right spirits and that's our job as well, to make sure we're still competing and growing, but we got to try to find a win.

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on avoiding a losing mentality for young players
quotes.excerpt: For the guys in the first couple years, you don't want to learn a losing mentality.
quotes.quote: For the guys in the first couple years, you don't want to learn a losing mentality. Regardless of the record, we got to come in here and do our work. We got to prepare like we're winning because they don't know any better. I've been in these situations early on where you're losing a lot of games and it becomes a normalized thing and it shouldn't be that way, especially in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on recent progress and building on positives
quotes.excerpt: You just got to build on the positives and try to negate the negatives.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing was we were having full-blown quarters where we were playing well and then we went away from what we were doing good. Coming out in the third quarter, I think we did a good job last game. We're starting to take more threes, so that helps out our math game a little bit. You just got to build on the positives and try to negate the negatives.

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on the trade of Nick and his new opportunity
quotes.excerpt: He's starting off his NBA career with a team and then you go to another one.
quotes.quote: It sucks. I talked to him. It sucks in the standpoint that he's starting off his NBA career with a team and then you go to another one in the middle of the season. That's tough. I've been traded mid-season, but I was in my 11th year. He's going to a championship-quality team. I told him it's a great opportunity. He's getting the opportunity to go out there and play. I just want him to have that confidence to continue to believe in himself just like the new team is believing in him.

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on Nick's role and development on a new team
quotes.excerpt: He'll be in a supportive role but then he'll have opportunities to go and find his game.
quotes.quote: He's got to find his niche. Early on in the NBA, you got to find your niche because then you're able to find a role and then you can improve on that. Especially with a championship-quality team like them, they're going to put him in a situation where he's supporting guys like Shay, Williams, and Chet when they come back. He'll be in a supportive role but then he'll have opportunities to go and find his game as well, so just be confident in that role and always show something.

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on Ben's return and positive energy
quotes.excerpt: It's good seeing him with a smile on his face. He's always happy regardless of his situation.
quotes.quote: It's really cool, man. It's good seeing him with a smile on his face. He's always happy regardless of his situation where it's not a happy situation in all things. It really sucks and it's super unfortunate, but he's not letting it affect him, which isn't affecting us. Just to see him around here encouraging guys, he's in good spirits.

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on Derek Carr's golf game and family
quotes.excerpt: He's a hell of a golfer. I think he's like a plus one right now.
quotes.quote: I've known DC for a while. He throws a football a little bit better, but it was good to see him and his family, his kids. I went over there and got them some gifts, got them some Lavine jerseys. I know he was also here because Dame and I, he's from Oakland, but big Raider fans and I've known DC for a while. He's a hell of a golfer. I think he's like a plus one right now, so retired life's been treating him good.
